title: Quatz
extract:
The Quatz is a Grineer quad-barreled sidearm that fires  Electricity bullets with a high fire rate and deadly accuracy, alternating between automatic shots from hip-fire with high status chance or a four-round simultaneous burst from aimed fire with increased critical chance and critical multiplier. Reloading from an empty magazine also discharges an  Electricity pulse that stuns nearby enemies.
This weapon can be sold for ‍ 5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Electricity damage.
Hip-fire shoots fully-automatic rounds.
Aimed fire shoots four rounds simultaneously in a burst.
Uniquely fires all four shots simultaneously instead of consecutively, reducing the chance of one missing.
Each shot lands in a small square formation around where the user is aiming instead of directly on the crosshair, which may lead to misses against smaller targets.
Reloading from a fully depleted magazine produces an 8 meter shockwave that deals 10  Electricity damage with 100% status chance and an additional 1 forced electricity proc.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Shockwave does not require line of sight.
Has 100% damage falloff over its radius, dealing 0 damage at the edge of its range.
Is affected by base damage, faction damage, status chance, status damage, status duration, and  Energizing Shot.
Is not affected by multishot, elemental mods (will not add damage or change damage type), and  Synth Charge.
Has 0% critical chance and a 0x critical multiplier.
Critical chance can be increased with flat bonuses like  Arcane Avenger or  Covenant.
Critical damage can be increased with flat bonuses like  Arcane Crepuscular or  Tenacious Bond.

Acquisition
The Quatz's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
Firing from hip-fire and then zooming in will not disrupt the full-auto fire until the trigger is released or the weapon's magazine is fully depleted.
Respectively, firing from aimed state and then zooming out will not disrupt the burst fire mode.
Alternating the aiming mode while firing will not change the initial firing mode base stats except accuracy.
Zooming in with full-auto increases accucary, while zooming out with burst-mode decreases it.
When the weapon's magazine is fully depleted, reloading will produce a shockwave that stuns enemies with a guaranteed  Electricity proc, but deals negligible damage.
On console weapon may automatically reload before weapon is empty. Will not release electrical shockwave when this happens.
In the event that the Instant Reload buff from  Charm is active when the magazine is emptied, the shockwave will not generate while the magazine is instantly refilled.

Tips
The hip-fire full-auto mode's high status chance allows it to apply procs rapidly, while the aimed fire burst mode's high critical chance and critical multiplier inflicts heavy raw damage.
With  Energizing Shot equipped, the shockwave upon reloading with an empty clip will pick up energy orbs.

Trivia
The Quatz has two unique reloading animations:
The first, which occurs when reloading with ammunition still in, has the Warframe toss the weapon and catch it by its barrel, ejecting the capacitor and putting in a new one, then tosses the weapon again and catches it by its grip.
The second, which occurs from a fully depleted magazine, is similar to the first, but instead, the weapon is caught using the opposite hand, and the capacitor is slammed into the gun with the gun hand more forcefully while producing an  Electricity shockwave.
The Quatz is the second weapon that utilizes different Trigger Types from aiming rather than Alternate Fire.
The first weapon was the  Buzlok before its rework in Update 20.0 (2017-03-24), having a semi-auto trigger type upon aiming instead of automatic.
Quatz is derived from the corruption of Quartz, a very common crystal of silicon dioxide. Its  Electricity damage and the discharge produced while reloading references the piezoelectric property of Quartz, the ability to produce a voltage upon the mechanical deformation of the crystal structure.
